evidence.observation: R23StageDirectHold queues two D3D11 CopyResource operations from producer-owned shared DirectGPU textures into host-owned hold textures, then immediately marks the hold valid. No completion query is attached at staging time.
evidence.observation2: R32 EVENT is ended later on the same D3D11 immediate context and ACK is published only after GetData reports completion. Therefore normal fast-submit ordering covers the queued hold copies plus projection sampling before ACK; the source comment saying the EVENT covers copy+projection is consistent with immediate-context ordering.
evidence.remaining_visual_risk: R23DirectHold.valid becomes true before GPU completion. Any fallback/grace path that samples hold textures before the R32 EVENT-protected submission path has established ordering could consume incompletely copied data. The post-review must prove all hold consumers are ordered on the same immediate context and that no producer ACK/reuse occurs before the copy-completion fence for that frame.

disposition: Do not approve candidate until a deterministic verifier traces StageDirectHold -> all hold consumers -> ArmConsumptionFence -> PollCompletedAcks/PublishCompletedFrame and proves ACK cannot precede completion of both CopyResource commands. Prefer explicit per-frame hold readiness/ownership invariant or a bounded completion fence if any alternate consumer/ACK path bypasses R32.
